environment.description: Same application deployed on EKS Fargate with a Pod Security context. The node uses Bottlerocket OS with a read-only root filesystem. The container image includes ImageMagick 6.9.12 but the pod spec mounts a ConfigMap at /etc/ImageMagick-6/policy.xml. Additionally, the pod runs with a seccomp profile loaded from a RuntimeDefault annotation, and the EKS cluster has a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'restrict-proc-mount' enforcing baseline PSS. The task IAM role has no permissions beyond s3:PutObject on a single output bucket.

imagemagick_policy_configmap.name: imagemagick-restrictive-policy

network_policy.note: Denies all egress except to VPC endpoints on 443

config.imds_access: disabled (EKS Fargate does not expose IMDS to pods)
